UPDATE new_settimane
SET
  `6ManualeGioielleria` = {{Rating51Copy.value}},
  `6NoteManualeGioielleria` = '{{Input51Copy.text}}',
  `6Turno` = {{Rating52Copy.value}},
  `6NoteTurno` = '{{Input52Copy.text}}',
  `6Apertura` = {{Rating53Copy.value}},
  `6NoteApertura` = '{{Input53Copy.text}}',
  `6Chiusura` = {{Rating54Copy.value}},
  `6NoteChiusura` = '{{Input54Copy.text}}',
  `6Vetrine` = {{Rating55Copy.value}},
  `6NoteVetrine` = '{{Input55Copy.text}}',
  ModificatoDa6 = '{{appsmith.user.name + "_" + moment().format("YYYYMMDD_HHmmss")}}'
WHERE IdSettimane = {{TabellaSettimane.triggeredRow.IdDipendenti}};
